newsitem.title: UK: Hamleys says Aug-Dec sales up 3.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hamleys says Aug-Dec sales up 3.6 pct.

text.p: British toy store group Hamleys Plc said on Thursday sales in the five months between August and December 1996 rose 3.6 percent.
The company said in a statement sales were up 5.6 percent in the 11 months from February to December 1996.
Hamleys said Christmas trading started well but sales in the three weeks up to Christmas were below the previous year.
Sales in the year to date are above last year, Hamleys said.
A spokesman for the company said the comparisons are on a like-for-like basis. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 4017
